EGY.note: Only the 2023 Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI is named, with no legal effect stated.
No government body's use of an AI system stated.
Applied Innovation Center solutions for agriculture and healthcare are named without any system in service in a public sector system.

facts.fact: The ICT Minister said Egypt launched the second edition of its National AI Strategy 2025-2030 in January 2025, built on six pillars.
The ICT Minister said the Applied Innovation Center is carrying out projects building systems for Arabic language recognition, speech-to-text and multilingual translation.

EGY.note: Only a call for personal data protection in AI governance; no law stated.

facts.fact: MCIT and UNESCO launched a National Stakeholder Consultation under the AI Readiness Assessment, covering policies and legislation among four areas, with public and private sector, academia, civil society and young entrepreneurs taking part.
